reviews.text: A beautiful center with large, separate spaces for working with dogs safely.
Serious and well-prepared technicians. I found expertise, passion, and motivation.
Excellent dog training camp, we went there with high school students for a civil protection project

A few months after completing the advanced course (after taking the basic one), I recommend their courses to everyone.

Preface: My first dog, adopted from a shelter as an adult, so I'm handicapped and he's a bit insecure.
The positive reinforcement method is effective and low-stress for both of us. Behavior exercises help me overcome critical situations during daily walks. I've learned to communicate more clearly with Bobby, and he's demonstrated many talents and skills.
Added to this, it's a way to support the Civil Protection Agency and, for a city dog, it's a fun and rewarding activity.
